overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, with dry fuels (ERC 60%, BI 56%) offset by cool temps and calm winds.**
- ERC/BI readings climb through midweek (ERC 66% by Oct 10) before easing by Oct 12, keeping the rating Moderate all week.
- Light northeast winds (5 mph) and a slight chance of afternoon showers keep fire spread potential low today; a cooling, wetter pattern arrives this weekend with up to 0.25" rain possible Oct 12.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area.
- Montrose County lifted its Stage 1 fire restrictions for unincorporated areas on September 16, and no restrictions are currently in effect there. Gunnison County has also been free of fire restrictions since mid-September.
- Statewide fire activity remains quiet following beneficial late-season moisture, with no significant wildfires burning as of Oct. 4. No active incidents are reported in or near this area's counties.
